description: Conservation of ACC synthase active-site residues in mammalian ACCSL and allele frequency of rs2074051
code:
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt, numpy as np, pandas as pd, json
fig, axes = plt.subplots(1,2, figsize=(14,5.4), gridspec_kw={'width_ratios':[1.5,1]})

# Panel A: conservation heat-map of catalytic positions
tbl = pd.read_csv("ortholog_catalytic_residue_table.csv", index_col=0)
roles = [r for r in tbl.index if r not in ('len','%id vs tomACS')]
species = list(tbl.columns)
tomato_wt = {'Leu53*':'L','Ala54*':'A','PLP-phos loop G':'G','PLP-phos loop A':'A','PLP-phos loop T':'T',
             'Asn131':'N','Tyr152 (PLP phos)':'Y','Arg157 (substrate)':'R','Thr205':'T','Asn209':'N',
             'Asp237 (pyridine N1)':'D','Ile239':'I','Tyr240 (stack)':'Y','Ser275':'S','Ser277':'S',
             'Lys278 (Schiff base)':'K','Arg286 (PLP phos)':'R','Arg412 (substrate a-COO-)':'R'}
M=np.zeros((len(roles), len(species)))
ann=[]
for i,r in enumerate(roles):
    row=[]
    for jx,sp in enumerate(species):
        v=str(tbl.loc[r,sp]); aa=v[0]
        M[i,jx]= 1.0 if aa==tomato_wt[r] else 0.0
        row.append(v)
    ann.append(row)
ax=axes[0]
ax.imshow(M, cmap='RdYlGn', vmin=0, vmax=1, aspect='auto')
ax.set_xticks(range(len(species))); ax.set_xticklabels(species, rotation=30, ha='right', fontsize=9)
ax.set_yticks(range(len(roles)))
ax.set_yticklabels([f"{r}  [tomato {tomato_wt[r]}]" for r in roles], fontsize=8)
for i in range(len(roles)):
    for jx in range(len(species)):
        ax.text(jx,i,ann[i][jx], ha='center', va='center', fontsize=7.5)
ax.set_title('Active-site residues of plant ACC synthase mapped onto mammalian ACCSL / ACCS\n'
             'green = identical to tomato ACS, red = substituted', fontsize=10)

# Panel B: allele frequency of rs2074051
ax=axes[1]
pops=['AFR','EAS','SAS','EUR','AMR','global\n(1000G)','global\n(gnomAD v4.1)']
argf=[0.896,0.843,0.766,0.780,0.589,0.794,0.7586]
cysf=[1-x for x in argf]
y=np.arange(len(pops))
ax.barh(y, argf, color='#2F9E44', label='Arg529 (rs2074051 C)')
ax.barh(y, cysf, left=argf, color='#C92A2A', label='Cys529 (reference, rs2074051 T)')
for i,v in enumerate(argf): ax.text(v/2, i, f"{v:.2f}", va='center', ha='center', color='w', fontsize=9)
ax.set_yticks(y); ax.set_yticklabels(pops, fontsize=9); ax.invert_yaxis()
ax.set_xlabel('allele frequency'); ax.set_xlim(0,1)
ax.set_title('The UniProt/GRCh38 reference Cys529 is the minor allele', fontsize=10)
ax.legend(fontsize=8, loc='lower right')
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
